entries.summary: Implemented per-user GitHub video segmentation with per-course repos. YouTube-like video player with auto-play, progress bar, chapters sidebar.
entries.details: New model: GitHubAccount (user, github_username, github_token). Removed repo_name field. API: GET/POST/DELETE /courses/github/ + GET /courses/{id}/github/. Video upload uses user's GitHub token with per-course repos. Default segment_duration=60 seconds. YouTube player: VideoPlayer.tsx with auto-play, single progress bar with chapter markers, chapters sidebar.
entries.code:
POST /api/courses/github/ {github_username, github_token}
DELETE /api/courses/github/
GET /api/courses/{id}/github/ - returns repo_url, lessons, segments
POST /api/courses/video-upload/ {file, lesson_id, segment_duration}

# segment_duration default = 60 seconds (1 minute)
# VideoPlayer.tsx - YouTube-like player
# styles.css - yt-player classes
decisions: Each course gets its own repo: aura-course-{course-slug}
Each lesson is a folder: lesson-{id}-{title}
User can override segment_duration via API (30-3600 seconds)
YouTube-like player with auto-play, progress bar, chapters sidebar
